facts.home_lead: KidsWatch creates each child's local Jellyfin user. Choose their library, plan screen time and bedtime, and request a pause from your phone. Companion controls only; no guaranteed cutoff.
facts.home_intro: Jellyfin edition preview. No public build is available yet. Parents use an existing local Jellyfin identity; children need no email or outside signup. Run the server?
facts.feature_intro: Children use their normal Jellyfin apps. KidsWatch organizes library choices and requests stops; native policies and stop requests do not guarantee title security or a cutoff for any client.
facts.title_selection: Use an allow list or block list, or switch to "Only titles I allow" for a handpicked library. Selection rules stop at PG-13 movies and TV-14 shows; R, NC-17, TV-MA, unknown and unrated titles are excluded. Filtering a library is not secure playback blocking. Whole-series choices include new episodes; episode ratings still apply, with no episode exceptions.
facts.screen_time: Set daily minutes and watch hours for school days and weekends. Usage depends on player reports. When a limit is reached, KidsWatch requests a stop; buffered video may continue and there is no guaranteed cutoff.
facts.stop_message: KidsWatch: A parent paused Jellyfin for now. Ask them when you can watch again.
facts.stop_caption: Observed Jellyfin message, shown as a small toast. Jellyfin client behavior varies; a message or accepted stop request does not prove playback ended.
facts.stop_speed: Stop requests depend on the client; playback may continue and no cutoff is guaranteed
facts.history: A 7-day chart compares reported usage with the limit, alongside parent changes and stop requests. An unconfirmed result must stay unconfirmed; server outages and stale sessions need attention.
facts.all_screens: Rules follow your child's local Jellyfin user. Player behavior varies, and no client is certified for strict enforcement.
facts.safety: Downloads, disconnected players, casting and saved adult accounts can bypass the intended experience. Test and restrict those paths before family use.
facts.child_setup: Sign in with your existing Jellyfin identity after parent approval. Add a child and pick their rules; KidsWatch creates a local child user with no outside account or email.
facts.child_ready: Verified children activate with trusted parents enabled; otherwise they stay disabled until owner approval. Sign in the TV with Quick Connect or parent-assisted child login.
facts.release_copy: The Jellyfin edition is a preview. No public download, release image or installation script is available yet. Explore the planned setup with your server owner.
facts.license: Planned for your own Jellyfin server. Companion controls, not a safety lock; strict enforcement is false.
facts.project_footer: A Pughouse Labs project. Jellyfin edition preview; no public build is available yet.
facts.non_affiliation: KidsWatch is an independent project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Jellyfin project.
facts.analytics: This website counts visits with Cloudflare Web Analytics, which does not use cookies. Interactive previews use fictional data and stay in this browser tab.
facts.parent_lead: Watching on someone else's Jellyfin server? Choose a library, plan screen time and bedtime, and request a pause from your phone. This preview offers companion controls, with no guaranteed cutoff.
facts.parent_titles: Pick an age level, then allow or block a whole movie or series in the library selection. A known direct video link could still fetch a blocked title in our Jellyfin 12.3 lab.
facts.parent_time: Set daily minutes and watch hours separately. Extra minutes do not extend bedtime; a later bedtime does not add minutes. Usage depends on player reports, and loss of server contact needs owner attention.
facts.parent_activity: See reported usage, a 7-day chart, parent changes and why a stop was requested. A request and a confirmed stop should never look the same.
facts.child_library: The child browses their selected library in Jellyfin. Selection rules exclude adult and unrated titles, but direct links can bypass filtering. They do not see KidsWatch itself.
facts.child_stop: When a parent pauses or time runs out, KidsWatch requests a stop. Some clients show a small toast; others may keep playing. There is no guaranteed cutoff for any client.
facts.parent_account: Use an existing local Jellyfin adult identity, a private expiring invitation and owner-approved family access. The invitation alone grants no access.
facts.child_account_heading: A local Jellyfin user for each child
facts.child_account: KidsWatch creates the local user. No child email, outside signup or separate cloud account is needed. Parent approval and child activation are separate checks.
facts.owner_needs: The person who runs your Jellyfin server must review the preview, the known server bypass and actual device behavior. No public build is available yet.
facts.account_warning: Rules follow your child's local user. Shared TVs should not leave adult or admin accounts available for easy switching. Saved adult accounts bypass the intended experience.
facts.give_moment: An accepted stop request is not proof that viewing ended. Buffered video may continue, and even a cooperative player does not close the known direct-link bypass.
facts.share_message: Hi! Could you review the KidsWatch for Jellyfin preview? It plans local child users, library choices and family screen-time routines. There is no public build yet. It offers companion controls, not a safety lock: known direct links can bypass filtering and no client has a guaranteed cutoff. Please review the device results and planned setup: https://kidswatchtv.com/jellyfin/server-owners
facts.owner_lead: Give the families on your Jellyfin server a place to manage library choices, screen time and bedtime. You approve parents and choose the child approval policy. Companion controls only; no strict enforcement.
facts.owner_fine: Jellyfin edition preview. Planned to run beside Jellyfin with local users, native policies and stop requests. No public build is available yet.
facts.parent_access: Eligible local adult identities need an invitation and owner-approved parent access.
facts.connected_account: created a local Jellyfin child user
facts.normal_apps: Kids use normal Jellyfin apps. Test actual playback on each device; a saved policy or accepted stop request is not proof of enforcement.
facts.enable_parent: Invite an eligible local Jellyfin adult identity with a private expiring invitation. They sign in and request access; you approve the family role. The link alone grants no access.
facts.approve_child: KidsWatch creates and verifies a restricted local child user. With trusted parents on, future verified children can activate; otherwise they stay disabled until approval. Changing trust does not approve old requests.
facts.sharing: KidsWatch applies local user policies and title choices. Known direct video links still fetched blocked titles in our Jellyfin 12.3 lab, even after playback was turned off. Policy readback is not proof of secure blocking.
facts.keeper: KidsWatch checks reported playback and requests a stop when limits are reached. Show unavailable-server and unsupported-player warnings separately from the known server bypass; no client has a guaranteed cutoff.
facts.about: KidsWatch for Jellyfin is a self-hosted preview for family library choices and time routines. Native controls are a best-effort companion, with no strict title security or guaranteed cutoff.
facts.owner_titles: Parents pick Little kids, Kids or Teens and whole-series title choices. Selection excludes R, NC-17, TV-MA, unknown and unrated titles; filtering is not secure playback blocking.
facts.owner_activity: A 7-day chart of reported usage, parent changes and recorded stop requests. Unconfirmed playback outcomes must stay unconfirmed.
facts.owner_approval: Only invited eligible local adults can request parent access. Parent approval and child activation are separate checks. The owner controls trusted parents and answers requests.
facts.subscription_heading: A dedicated owner-created admin integration key.
facts.subscription: Store it in Vaultwarden and mount it as a protected runtime secret. It is privileged server access and stays on the backend; parents never need it.
facts.owner_child_heading: A restricted local Jellyfin user for each child,
facts.owner_child: created by KidsWatch and verified before device setup. No outside account or email address is needed.
facts.optional_extras: Match the household timezone on both services, choose the child approval policy and verify owner notifications before inviting parents.
facts.cloud: No outside child signup or cloud account. Parents use existing local Jellyfin identities. The privileged integration key stays on the backend.
facts.settings: The owner configures protected HTTPS access and selected libraries. Keep the dedicated integration key in protected runtime storage and out of parent devices, chat and logs.
facts.security_note: It can create local Jellyfin users and change native policies. Treat it like privileged server access: use HTTPS, private backups and protected runtime secrets.
facts.install_intro: The Jellyfin edition is a preview. There is no public download, release image or installation script yet. These paths describe planned setup, not an installer you can run today.
facts.agent_intro: Use this preview planning prompt with your assistant. It asks about hosting, protected secrets, the known bypass and device tests. It must not invent a download or install an unavailable public build.
facts.agent_safety: Keep the privileged Jellyfin integration key on the backend and out of chat. Ask for backups and an undo note before any future installation.
facts.install_prompt:
Help me plan for the KidsWatch for Jellyfin preview. No public build, download, release image or installation script is available yet. Do not invent one or install the Plex edition as a substitute.

Ask where Jellyfin runs, which movie and TV libraries to use, the household timezone, protected HTTPS access, owner notifications and the child approval policy. Plan a dedicated owner-created admin integration key kept in Vaultwarden and mounted as a protected runtime secret on the backend. Parents use existing local adult identities and private expiring invitations; invitation links alone grant no access. KidsWatch creates restricted local child users, with no outside signup or email. Plan Quick Connect and parent-assisted child login.

Explain the limits before proposing family use: companion controls, not a safety lock. In the Jellyfin 12.3 lab, known direct video links fetched blocked titles even with playback disabled. Policy readback, a health check and accepted Stop requests do not prove enforcement. Buffered video may continue. No strict title security or guaranteed cutoff for any client; strict enforcement is false. The Android TV lab client cooperated; the Android phone app kept playing. Physical devices, iOS/tvOS and Roku are untested.

For a future reviewed release, start on a test server with fictional children, private backups and separate KidsWatch storage. Test title choices, watch hours, daily minutes, pause, reconnecting, downloads, disconnected players, casting and adult account switching. Record actual playback outcomes separately from stop requests, and server failures separately from the known bypass. Show a plan and wait for approval before changes. Keep secrets out of chat, logs, shell history and the repository. Keep matching backups and clear undo instructions; verify child sign-in after any restore.
facts.manual_intro: Preview planning only. Back up Jellyfin, keep KidsWatch storage separate and start with fictional children on a test server. Detailed installation instructions will accompany a reviewed release.
facts.device_lock: Known direct video links fetched blocked titles in our Jellyfin 12.3 lab, even after playback was turned off. Playback setup and direct streaming still worked. Buffered video may continue. No strict title security or guaranteed cutoff for any client.
facts.sync_delay: Library selections and native policy readback do not prove secure playback blocking. Test the actual child experience and record results for the exact version.
facts.platform_changes: Jellyfin server and client behavior can change. Readiness stays at companion controls only; a connected server, saved policies or a successful health check do not prove title security or a cutoff.
facts.cost: The Jellyfin edition is a preview, with no public build or download available yet. No outside child account or Plex subscription is needed.
facts.subscription_question: Does a parent need the admin integration key?
facts.subscription_answer: No. Parents use their existing local Jellyfin identity and need owner-approved family access. The privileged integration key stays on the backend.
facts.child_question: Does each child need an email address?
facts.child_answer: No. KidsWatch creates a restricted local Jellyfin user for each child. There is no external child signup or Plex share to accept. Sign in the TV with Quick Connect or parent-assisted child login.
facts.bypass_answer: Yes. Known direct video links fetched blocked titles even with playback disabled in the Jellyfin 12.3 lab. Downloads, disconnected players, casting and saved adult accounts can bypass the intended experience. Shared TVs should not leave adult or admin accounts available for easy switching.
facts.offline: Usage depends on player reports. If the server is offline, contact is lost or sessions are stale, the owner needs to check it. Time accounting can be incomplete, and stop requests do not guarantee playback ended.
facts.remove_answer: . For a future reviewed Jellyfin release, use its matching instructions and backups, review only the local child users it created and verify sign-in after a restore.
facts.runtime_heading: Companion controls, not a safety lock
facts.runtime_summary: In our Jellyfin 12.3 lab, known direct video links still fetched blocked titles, even after playback was turned off. There is no guaranteed cutoff for any client. Native policies and stop requests do not guarantee title security. Strict enforcement is false.
facts.runtime_devices: Device results: the Android TV lab client cooperated; the Android phone app kept playing. Physical devices, iOS/tvOS and Roku are untested. Jellyfin Web 12.3.0, in an isolated foreground H.264 direct-play test in Chromium 154, showed a message and Stop closed the player. That one cooperative path does not close the server bypass. Android TV source supports stop and messages, but both player engines and physical devices need runtime tests. Swiftfin source supports stop; do not promise a friendly message without testing the installed version. Treat Roku remote stop and messages as unsupported for this preview. No client is certified for strict enforcement.
facts.parent_profile_note: If a child uses an adult account, child rules do not apply. Keep adult and admin identities unavailable for easy switching on shared TVs.
facts.private_storage: Keep local child identities, rules, usage, requests, integration secrets and any matching backups private. The preview does not connect this website to your server.
facts.admin_security: Owner invitations, parent approval and child activation are separate checks. An invitation alone grants no access. Protect HTTPS access and verify owner notifications before inviting parents.
facts.availability: Self-hosted preview · No public build yet
facts.account_tip_title: Sign in the TV with Quick Connect.
facts.account_tip_body: Choose the verified child in KidsWatch. Start Quick Connect on their Jellyfin device and confirm “Sign this device in as [child].” If unavailable, use parent-assisted child login.
facts.account_tip_after: No outside child account or email address is needed.
facts.update_guide: The Jellyfin edition has no public build yet. Follow the matching instructions with a future reviewed release; do not reuse Plex installation or cleanup commands.
facts.remove_guide: Keep matching private backups and setup notes. Stop KidsWatch before restoring an earlier configuration. Review only the local child users it created, protect the privileged integration key, and check device sign-in again after a restore.
facts.notification_heading: A private way to receive owner notifications.
facts.notification_requirement: Verify owner notifications before inviting parents. Keep privileged server access on the backend, and review the planned setup with the server owner.

manual_steps.title: Back up and keep it separate
manual_steps.body: Before a future installation, back up Jellyfin and use separate KidsWatch storage. Begin with fictional children on a test server so you can check behavior and undo changes.

manual_steps.title: Connect your server privately
manual_steps.body: Configure protected HTTPS access, choose movie and TV libraries and keep the dedicated owner-created admin integration key in Vaultwarden, mounted as a protected runtime secret on the backend. Parents never need that key.

manual_steps.title: Choose the household settings
manual_steps.body: Match the household timezone on both services, set the child approval policy and verify owner notifications before inviting parents. Check each local child user and restrictions before device sign-in.

manual_steps.title: Invite parents and verify children
manual_steps.body: Choose eligible local Jellyfin adult identities and private expiring invitations. The link alone grants no access. Approve parent access separately from child activation. Trusted parents can activate future verified children; changing trust does not approve old requests.

manual_steps.title: Help sign in the TV
manual_steps.body: Choose the verified child in KidsWatch. Start Quick Connect on the Jellyfin device and confirm the child identity. If unavailable, use parent-assisted child login. No external child signup or email is needed.

manual_steps.title: Test the devices your family uses
manual_steps.body: Try title choices, watch hours, daily minutes, pause, reconnecting, shared TVs, downloads, disconnected players, casting and saved adult accounts. Record actual outcomes separately from accepted stop requests. The Android TV lab client cooperated; the Android phone app kept playing. Physical devices, iOS/tvOS and Roku are untested.

manual_steps.title: Review the known server bypass
manual_steps.body: Companion controls, not a safety lock. In the Jellyfin 12.3 lab, known direct video links fetched blocked titles even with playback turned off. Playback setup and direct streaming still worked; buffered video may continue. No strict title security or guaranteed cutoff for any client. Strict enforcement is false.

manual_steps.title: Keep a way back
manual_steps.body: Keep matching private backups and setup notes. Stop KidsWatch before restoring an earlier configuration, review only the child users it created, and check device sign-in after a restore. Detailed installation instructions will accompany a reviewed release.
